MEL_MINIMAP.Title: Minimap
MEL_MINIMAP.AutoOpen: Open minimap when the world starts
MEL_MINIMAP.DynamicSizeHint: Allows the minimap to be resized while preserving the map aspect ratio.
MEL_MINIMAP.Keybindings.ActorSheet.Name: Open Actor Sheet or Journal
MEL_MINIMAP.Keybindings.ActorSheet.Hint: Opens the hovered Token's Actor Sheet or a hovered Map Note's linked Journal Entry.
MEL_MINIMAP.Keybindings.ViewArtwork.Name: View Actor Artwork
MEL_MINIMAP.Keybindings.ViewArtwork.Hint: Opens the hovered Token's artwork in a local window.
MEL_MINIMAP.Keybindings.ShareArtwork.Hin: Shows the hovered Token's artwork to all players. GM only.
